final_text:
Submitted as run_id ADD-03-host-20261005T031229Z-fd07, status "partial"; no crops read (both provisions and VOL-II:3.4 are text-layer, so no image applied). Partial is expected: this batch answers only 5.1 and 5.2 of ADD-03's 54 provisions. Both items are pending and need a person:

- **ADD-03/5.1** (replace text in VOL-II:3.4) is marked "conflicting" because I flagged two problems. First, the ADD-03 cover summary says the odour criterion changes in "Volume II Clause 3.5", but 3.5 is the noise clause and 5.1 itself names 3.4. Second, the new odour limit is only in Figure 7-2 of the Environmental and Social Impact Assessment, which is not in the pack, so the new limit has no number. I also fixed the reference draft's "OU/m3" to "OU/m³", as the clause prints it.
- **ADD-03/5.2** (a note on VOL-II:3.4 recording the new duty to show compliance in the Technical Proposal) is marked "insufficient_evidence". It rests on my reading that this adds a new obligation, and showing compliance needs the same missing Figure 7-2 value.
